rules.identity_chain: Ship x/y/z/epoch -> zero-key Sector -> counted zero-key CelestialSignal -> source_signal_identifier-bound zero-key CelestialBody
rules.stable_identifier_caveat: This catalogs the honest canonical state path; SDK-level rejection of additional initial object entries remains an external requirement.
rules.scan_threshold_note: The exponent is a deterministic whole-object eligibility threshold for a named Scan action, not a stable-identifier selector or output lottery. Global availability also depends on the explicitly selected Survey profile and its category-slot counts.
